content: Datadog Bits AI SRE: continuous observe-reason-act loop forming/validating hypotheses over telemetry, converges on root cause, delivers conclusion to Slack/Teams/Jira/ServiceNow before humans log in; 7 triage actions (paging, incident creation, ticketing); Action Catalog now includes Trigger/Get/List Investigation for automated remediation hooks; grounded against thousands of real incidents.
